objective: Use upstream and pre-W1 information, native compensation-aware action values, and cross-block/step coupling to discover a defensible quality-preserving dynamic FFN computation method with real execution advantage

novelty_policy.do: Search closest papers, source code and adjacent domains for promising components; adapt or combine similar methods as comparators and candidate building blocks
novelty_policy.only_duplicate_screen: Substantially complete equivalence of information timing, actual operator/actions, compensation, measured causal objective, and claimed operating regime
novelty_policy.if_equivalent: Credit as BASELINE_OR_REPRODUCTION, or identify a testably distinct construction before independent novelty claim
novelty_policy.if_overlapping: KEEP_EXPLORING_AND_COMPARE; sharing ingredients does not close an idea
novelty_policy.publication_claim: Do not state independent scientific originality without honest nearest-prior mechanism/implementation comparison

hypotheses.mechanism: Actual FFN group values couple via downstream error directions and complete compensation rather than inherent hidden GELU cross-coordinate nonlinearity
Pre-norm residual scale/attention updates contain low-cost information absent from post-Q1 summaries that predicts downstream action value
Sparse upstream contributions predict net action value at lower cost than evaluating dense intermediate activations
Temporal region-dependent propagation explains fidelity mismatch that magnitude/top-k misses

ordered_tasks.work: Audit R16/R17 source exposure and available operands; build positive prior-art extraction table
Separate native hidden additive behavior, compensation set dependence and metric action interaction on saved or synthetic exact-boundary checks
Measure residual-scale/attention update incremental action-value information; record missing captures explicitly
Recompute four-arm signed cross-layer response and propose new matched compensated group actions only if explanatory gap remains
Compare activation versus net action-value prediction and source-held-out regret
Test conditioned latent t0 versus later20, time/space risk and temporal-smooth controls
Native compensated action, full paired four-step free video, official nine-axis and whole-system timing

mandatory_comparators: Closest adapted Prox/FastForward/E-DiT/PARE/FIS-DiT/TAPE methods where meaningful
Oracle on exactly executable native action set
enforcement_notes: No unrelated parameter sweep as default fallback after failed/incomplete latest scope
Negative results apply only to their frozen method and data
A selected backup must run at least one full free student paired video before declaring video-safe
No automatic GPU or model execution
